headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 14, 2026**
article:
The Baltimore Orioles made a significant move by transferring left-handed pitcher Keegan Akin from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to left elbow discomfort. This change in status occurred on July 13, 2026. The Orioles also bolstered their pitching staff with the addition of Cam Sanders, who was traded from the Pittsburgh Pirates in exchange for cash.

Several players have been impacted by injuries, affecting their availability for their respective teams. Keegan Akin (Baltimore Orioles) has been transferred to the 60-day injured list due to left elbow discomfort. Other injured players include Zac Gallen (Arizona Diamondbacks) with right elbow inflammation, Chris Martin (Texas Rangers) with right shoulder impingement, Nick Lodolo (Cincinnati Reds) with a blister on his left index finger, William Kempner (Miami Marlins) with a right elbow sprain, Brandon Woodruff (Milwaukee Brewers) with right shoulder inflammation, Mike Yastrzemski (Atlanta Braves) with left elbow inflammation, and Anthony Banda (Minnesota Twins) with a left lat strain.

The MLB trade market has been active, with several teams making moves to bolster their rosters. The Baltimore Orioles acquired Cam Sanders from the Pittsburgh Pirates in exchange for cash. The Milwaukee Brewers traded for Braden Shewmake from the Houston Astros. The Chicago White Sox traded Brandon Eisert and Jacob Gonzalez to the Pittsburgh Pirates for Jaden Woods and future considerations. The Minnesota Twins acquired Tommy Nance from the Toronto Blue Jays in exchange for Ryan Sprock and future considerations.
